sloka: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतदुत्थायोत्थाय वानराः ।प्रणम्य शिरसा पादौ निर्जग्मुस्ते महाबलाः ।। ७.४०.२५ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu rāghavasyaitadutthāyotthāya vānarāḥ ।praṇamya śirasā pādau nirjagmuste mahābalāḥ ।। 7.40.25 ॥

translations.english: Having heard these words from Rama, those mighty monkeys repeatedly rose, bowed their heads at his feet, and then departed.
